manifest.title: SpaceRisk
manifest.tagline: ISO 31000 risk register with monthly team reviews
manifest.description:
SpaceRisk is a risk register built on ISO 31000, with monthly review cycles.

* Every team keeps its own risks, with likelihood × consequence scoring, treatment actions and owners.
* Each month, every team reviews its risks and its lead submits an attested return.
* Executive and team dashboards show a heat map, trends and risks above appetite.
* Excel export, plus a full data export and import as a single SQLite file.

Login is local to the app. Roles are executive, team lead and member.
manifest.changelog: * First Cloudron package.
manifest.postInstallMessage:
SpaceRisk starts **empty and reachable by anyone**. Until it has data, the `/restore` page lets
whoever opens it first upload a backup, including their own executive account. Do one of these
straight away:

* **Restore a backup:** open `$CLOUDRON-APP-ORIGIN/restore` and upload a file made with
  *Admin → Export all data* (or `flask export-data`).
* **Start fresh:** open the app's Web Terminal in the dashboard and run
  `cd /app/code && flask --app app create-executive <username> "<Full name>"`. It asks for a password.

Login is local to SpaceRisk and doesn't use Cloudron accounts.
